node.statement: At (P,g_V(P)), the derivative of Q mapsto Phi_V(P,Q) is exactly D_{A^perp}f_V(P+g_V(P)), which is invertible by the hypothesis of node 1; applying GT-lee-2ed-thm-C.40 with c=0 yields neighborhoods O_P,O_Q and a C^infinity F:O_P->O_Q such that Phi_V(P',Q')=0 in O_P x O_Q if and only if Q'=F(P').
